_meta.description: S4 inference proposals — HYPOTHESES, sourcing-gated. NEVER auto-promoted; review + source + promote by hand.

sibc.entity: Advances against Fixed Deposits (Including FCNR (B), NRNR Deposits etc.)
Advances to Individuals against share, bonds, etc.
Weaker Sections including net PSLC- SF/MF

proposals.label: Real-estate price recovery → housing loan demand
proposals.mechanism: Rising property prices increase transaction volumes and borrower willingness to leverage, boosting housing credit origination
proposals.required_source: NHB Residex or RBI residential property price index showing YoY appreciation
source_ladder: National Housing Bank Residex quarterly index publication
RBI Statistical Tables Relating to Banks in India - residential property price data
Knight Frank or Anarock quarterly residential price reports

triage.note: NHB Residex is a price index - an observable series we could ingest as a signal, not an external non-observable driver.

proposals.label: Equity market rally → margin-lending growth
proposals.mechanism: Bull market conditions drive retail investor appetite for leveraged equity positions through share-backed loans
proposals.required_source: NSE/BSE index movements and margin-funding data from SEBI or NSE disclosures
source_ladder: SEBI monthly bulletin on margin trading facility exposure
NSE monthly factsheet showing derivative and cash segment turnover
Business Standard or Economic Times reporting on retail investor margin activity

triage.note: SEBI margin-trading exposure is a published series, not a driver.

proposals.label: Vehicle scrappage policy → auto-loan demand
proposals.mechanism: Government scrappage incentives for old vehicles create replacement demand spurring new vehicle purchases financed via loans
proposals.required_source: MoRTH notification on Vehicle Scrappage Policy implementation and registration data
source_ladder: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways gazette notification on National Vehicle Scrappage Policy
MoRTH Vahan dashboard showing vehicle registration trends
SIAM monthly sales data and industry reports on scrappage-linked demand

triage.note: Now carried by force_vehicle_scrappage_replacement, authored 2026-09-09 from PIB PRID 2042966.

proposals.label: PLI manufacturing capex → corporate working-capital demand
proposals.mechanism: Production-Linked Incentive schemes trigger capacity expansion by large corporates requiring incremental working capital and term financing
proposals.required_source: DPIIT or Ministry notifications on PLI disbursements and sectoral approvals
source_ladder: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade PLI portal sectoral approvals and outlay data
Press Information Bureau releases on PLI scheme disbursements
CMIE Capex database showing announced manufacturing investments under PLI

proposals.label: Interest-subvention scheme renewal → education-loan uptake
proposals.mechanism: Government interest subsidies lower effective borrowing costs for students, increasing education loan applications and sanctions
proposals.required_source: Ministry of Education or Department of Higher Education scheme notifications on interest subvention
source_ladder: Ministry of Education circular on Central Sector Interest Subsidy Scheme for education loans
Press Information Bureau announcement on scheme budget allocation
Indian Banks' Association data or reports on education loan disbursements post-subsidy announcement

proposals.label: Kharif MSP hike → agriculture income expectations → credit demand
proposals.mechanism: Increased minimum support prices boost farmer income projections, raising creditworthiness and willingness to borrow for input financing
proposals.required_source: Commission for Agricultural Costs and Prices MSP announcement or Ministry of Agriculture notification
source_ladder: Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs press release announcing Kharif MSP increases
Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare official MSP notification
NABARD All India Rural Financial Inclusion Survey data on farmer credit uptake post-MSP hike

triage.note: Already carried by force_msp_procurement_growth, sourced 2026-09-09 to PIB PRID 2260618.

proposals.label: ECLGS extension → MSME credit availability
proposals.mechanism: Continued availability of Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme reduces lender risk, sustaining credit flow to micro, small and medium enterprises
proposals.required_source: Ministry of Finance or Department of Financial Services notification extending ECLGS tenure or corpus
source_ladder: Department of Financial Services Office Memorandum on ECLGS extension
Press Information Bureau release on ECLGS timeline and corpus expansion
National Credit Guarantee Trustee Company portal showing scheme utilization data

triage.note: Already carried by force_eclgs5_guarantee_window (Cabinet 2026-05-05, window to 2027-03-31).

proposals.label: Solar rooftop subsidy → renewable-energy loan demand
proposals.mechanism: Central or state subsidies for rooftop solar installations reduce upfront costs and make financed installations economically attractive
proposals.required_source: MNRE subsidy scheme notification or state nodal agency circulars on solar rooftop subsidy
source_ladder: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy notification on rooftop solar subsidy scheme phase or rate revision
State nodal agency circular on subsidy disbursement process
Bridge to India or Mercom India solar market reports showing subsidy-driven installation uptake

proposals.label: Infrastructure National Monetisation Pipeline → social-infrastructure project credit
proposals.mechanism: Government asset monetisation creates revenue streams for infrastructure projects, improving creditworthiness and unlocking bank financing for social infrastructure
proposals.required_source: NITI Aayog National Monetisation Pipeline report or Department of Economic Affairs updates
source_ladder: NITI Aayog National Monetisation Pipeline Volume 1 report listing social infrastructure assets
Department of Economic Affairs monthly report on monetisation progress
Credit rating agency reports or project finance trackers showing social-sector lending linked to NMP

proposals.label: SHG-bank linkage program expansion → weaker-sections credit
proposals.mechanism: Increased government or NABARD support for Self-Help Group financing expands formal credit access for economically weaker sections
proposals.required_source: NABARD Status of Microfinance in India report or Ministry of Rural Development SHG-bank linkage data
source_ladder: NABARD Annual Report chapter on SHG-Bank Linkage Programme with disbursement statistics
Ministry of Rural Development Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission progress report
RBI Financial Inclusion Report data on SHG credit outstanding

proposals.label: Consumer-price inflation → secured-borrowing substitution for consumption
proposals.mechanism: Rising living costs push households to prefer low-rate secured loans (housing, gold, FD-backed) over expensive unsecured credit for consumption smoothing
proposals.required_source: Ministry of Statistics CPI inflation series showing persistent elevation above policy target
source_ladder: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation monthly CPI press release
RBI Database on Indian Economy CPI combined inflation time series
CMIE Consumer Pyramids Household Survey data on borrowing behavior during inflation episodes

triage.note: CPI is a published series; if it drives credit the force is the policy response, not the index.

proposals.label: NBFC refinance window expansion → retail-credit intermediation
proposals.mechanism: Expanded RBI or NABARD refinance facilities for NBFCs lower their funding costs, enabling competitive retail loan origination that banks report as NBFC exposure or co-lending
proposals.required_source: RBI or NABARD circular announcing refinance scheme expansion or rate revision for NBFCs
source_ladder: RBI circular on refinance facility for NBFCs under specific scheme or liquidity window
NABARD circular on refinance support to NBFC-MFIs or vehicle-finance NBFCs
ICRA or CRISIL report on NBFC funding costs and origination trends post-refinance announcement

proposals.label: Micro-ATM regulatory sunset → infrastructure decline
proposals.mechanism: RBI withdrawal or non-renewal of micro-ATM certification standards causes deployment contraction
proposals.required_source: RBI Master Direction on Cash Withdrawal through Micro ATMs – specifically any 2023-2024 amendments on certification, interoperability mandates, or permitted-entity lists
source_ladder: RBI Master Direction - Information Technology Framework (or successor directive on Micro ATMs)
RBI Monthly Bulletin statistical tables on BC/BCA infrastructure counts
Economic Times / Business Standard coverage of micro-ATM policy changes

proposals.label: White-label ATM capital subsidy expiry → on-site ATM shift
proposals.mechanism: End of government subsidy or deployment incentive for white-label ATMs redirects capital toward bank-owned on-site locations with better unit economics
proposals.required_source: Ministry of Finance or NPCI circulars on ATM deployment incentives, or withdrawal of Financial Inclusion Fund support for off-site / white-label ATMs
source_ladder: Department of Financial Services annual report section on payment infrastructure support schemes
NPCI Annual Report table on ATM network composition and subsidy programs
Financial Express / Mint reports on white-label ATM operator exits or subsidy lapses

proposals.label: Credit-card cash-advance fee cap removal → ATM withdrawal uptick
proposals.mechanism: RBI removes or relaxes cap on cash-advance fees or interest-rate surcharges, making ATM withdrawals more profitable for issuers who then promote the channel
proposals.required_source: RBI Master Direction on Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct – check amendments to clauses on cash-advance pricing or interest-free period exclusions
source_ladder: RBI Master Direction on Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct (latest amendments)
RBI FAQs or press releases on credit card pricing reforms
Livemint / Business Standard articles on credit-card cash-advance fee changes

proposals.label: E-commerce merchant settlement timeline shortening → card acceptance growth
proposals.mechanism: RBI mandates faster settlement (T+1 or instant) for card e-commerce transactions, improving merchant liquidity and driving platform acceptance expansion
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on Payment System Settlement Timelines – specifically any 2023-2024 directive reducing T+2 to T+1 for card-not-present transactions
source_ladder: RBI Master Direction – Payment and Settlement Systems or specific circular on e-commerce settlement cycles
NPCI operational circular on card network settlement calendar changes
Economic Times coverage of RBI settlement-timeline reforms for online merchants

proposals.label: Fuel surcharge waiver reinstatement → debit POS value surge
proposals.mechanism: Government or oil marketing companies restore surcharge waivers or discounts for debit-card fuel purchases, concentrating POS spend at petrol pumps
proposals.required_source: Ministry of Petroleum notification or Indian Oil / BPCL / HPCL press release on fuel payment surcharge policy – check 2023-2024 for re-introduction of debit discount schemes
source_ladder: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas gazette notification on fuel retail payment terms
Indian Oil Corporation / BPCL press release on debit-card fuel discount schemes
Hindu BusinessLine or PTI coverage of fuel surcharge or discount policy changes

proposals.label: Cash-at-POS volume cap tightening → debit withdrawal decline
proposals.mechanism: RBI imposes or enforces stricter per-transaction or monthly limits on cash withdrawals at merchant POS terminals, curtailing the channel
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on Cash Withdrawal at Point of Sale (POS) – verify any 2023-2024 amendments lowering the Rs 2000 per-transaction or aggregate monthly cap
source_ladder: RBI circular DPSS.CO.PD No. (specific number) on Cash Withdrawal at PoS – check for cap revisions
RBI Annual Report section on retail payment regulation updates
Mint or Economic Times articles on POS cash-withdrawal limit changes

proposals.label: Festival-season e-commerce sale → credit/debit volume spike
proposals.mechanism: Diwali / festive-month discount events (BBD, GIF) concentrate e-commerce transactions in specific quarters, lifting card volumes in e-com and 'other' categories
proposals.required_source: NPCI or RBI payment-systems data release covering Oct-Nov period, or Flipkart / Amazon public sale-event GMV disclosures cross-referenced with card-network reports
source_ladder: RBI Payment Systems Indicators report (monthly) for Oct-Nov e-commerce transaction surge
Worldline India / Pine Labs public merchant-transaction index for festive-quarter peak
Economic Times coverage of Big Billion Days / Great Indian Festival GMV and payment-mode share

triage.note: Festival-season demand is seasonality, which the eval prompt explicitly bars as an invented explanation.

proposals.label: Tokenisation migration → 'other' transaction reclassification
proposals.mechanism: RBI's card-tokenisation mandate causes recurring / subscription transactions to shift from stored-credential to token-based flows, re-categorised from e-com to 'other' in issuer reporting
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on Card-on-File Tokenisation – verify phased enforcement deadlines in 2023-2024 and check if issuer MIS classification guidance changed post-migration
source_ladder: RBI circular on Tokenisation – Card Transactions (specific DPSS circular number and subsequent FAQs)
Payments Council of India or NPCI guidance note on transaction-category reporting post-tokenisation
Business Standard or Livemint coverage of tokenisation rollout impact on transaction classifications

triage.note: RBI card-on-file tokenisation enforcement completed 30 Sep 2022, four years before this movement window; a reporting reclassification then cannot explain a move now.

proposals.label: UPI-ATM interoperability → debit ATM volume shift to UPI
proposals.mechanism: NPCI launch of UPI-based cardless ATM withdrawal cannibalises traditional debit-card ATM transactions, but may not yet suppress volume if adoption is early-stage or limited to specific metros
proposals.required_source: NPCI press release or product circular on UPI ATM (cardless cash withdrawal) rollout timeline, participating banks, and transaction volume data
source_ladder: NPCI product launch announcement and adoption statistics for UPI ATM / UPI Cardless Cash
RBI Payment Systems Indicators – check if 'Prepaid Payment Instruments' or 'UPI' tables capture cardless ATM volumes separately
Moneycontrol or Economic Times coverage of UPI ATM feature launch and bank participation

proposals.label: Tier-2/3 city ATM refresh cycle → on-site ATM expansion
proposals.mechanism: Banks complete multi-year hardware refresh and expansion programs in smaller cities, mandated by RBI's revised ATM deployment norms or financial-inclusion targets
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on Geographic Distribution of ATMs and bank branch-expansion guidelines, or SBI / PNB annual report capex disclosures on Tier-2/3 ATM rollout programs
source_ladder: RBI Master Direction on Branch Authorisation – check clauses on ATM co-location and geographic spread requirements
State Bank of India Annual Report section on digital infrastructure and Tier-2/3 ATM deployment capex
Business Line or Hindu coverage of bank ATM expansion programs targeting smaller cities

proposals.label: Credit-card revolving interest-rate cap → outstanding balance dynamics
proposals.mechanism: Regulatory ceiling on revolving credit APR reduces issuer revenue per rupee outstanding, triggering tighter credit-line management and faster portfolio amortization
proposals.required_source: RBI circular imposing maximum interest rate on credit-card revolving balances
source_ladder: RBI Master Direction on Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022 or subsequent amendment circular
RBI Monthly Bulletin or Financial Stability Report discussing credit-card interest-rate regulation
Business Standard or Economic Times article citing RBI cap on credit-card interest rates with effective date

proposals.label: Co-branded card exit / restriction → card issuance mix
proposals.mechanism: Regulatory curbs on co-branded arrangements or specific issuer-partner tie-ups reduce co-brand card origination, which historically carried higher spend propensity
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on co-branded credit-card arrangements or issuer-specific enforcement action
source_ladder: RBI circular DOR.ACC.REC or similar reference restricting co-branded credit-card issuance terms
RBI press release or supervisory letter on credit-card partnerships
Mint or Moneycontrol report on RBI curbs affecting airline or retail co-brand credit cards

proposals.label: Reward-point liability accounting rule → issuer reward spend
proposals.mechanism: Change in accounting treatment of reward-point liabilities (fair-value vs historical cost) alters P&L recognition, prompting issuers to curtail reward redemption surfaces or card spend incentives
proposals.required_source: ICAI accounting standard update or RBI guidance on credit-card reward-point liability recognition
source_ladder: ICAI Ind AS 115 implementation guidance for credit-card loyalty programs or RBI circular on revenue recognition
IBA or industry association note on accounting for credit-card reward points
The Hindu BusinessLine or Financial Express article on credit-card reward accounting change

proposals.label: Add-on card issuance tightening → reported card stock vs unique borrowers
proposals.mechanism: Regulatory scrutiny or issuer policy reduces add-on (supplementary) card issuance per primary account, deflating card count without equivalent drop in spend or outstandings
proposals.required_source: RBI circular or issuer policy document on add-on credit-card issuance criteria
source_ladder: RBI Master Direction amendment on supplementary credit-card issuance or KYC for add-on cards
Bank credit-card policy document or annual report disclosure on add-on card norms
Economic Times or Livemint article on banks reducing add-on credit-card issuance

proposals.label: E-commerce platform fee regulation → e-commerce transaction value
proposals.mechanism: Government or competition-authority cap on platform fees or mandatory choice architecture reduces e-commerce GMV growth, lowering e-commerce credit-card spend
proposals.required_source: MCA, CCI, or DPIIT notification on e-commerce platform fee or seller neutrality
source_ladder: Ministry of Consumer Affairs or Competition Commission of India order on e-commerce platform practices
DPIIT press release on e-commerce marketplace regulation
Business Standard article on e-commerce platform fee caps affecting payment volumes

proposals.label: Fuel surcharge waiver withdrawal → POS spend at fuel merchants
proposals.mechanism: Issuer cessation of fuel-surcharge waiver (historically 1-2.5% of transaction) reduces net value proposition for fuel spend on cards, shifting volume to alternate payment modes
proposals.required_source: Major card-issuer notification or website T&C update removing fuel surcharge waiver
source_ladder: HDFC Bank, SBI Card, or ICICI Bank credit-card terms amendment on fuel surcharge waiver withdrawal
Industry press release or investor presentation mentioning fuel-spend incentive changes
Moneycontrol or Mint article on end of fuel surcharge waiver by credit-card issuers

triage.note: Issuer card terms (hdfcbank/sbicard/icicibank) are not on the allowlist and change without a dated public instrument.

proposals.label: Airport lounge access rationalization → premium card retention
proposals.mechanism: Reduction in complimentary airport lounge visits or third-party lounge network access diminishes perceived premium card value, raising attrition among high-spend cardholders
proposals.required_source: Card network (Visa/Mastercard) or issuer communication on lounge access policy change
source_ladder: Visa Infinite or Mastercard World Elite program update on lounge access entitlements
Issuer email or website notification to cardholders on lounge benefit revision
Livemint or Economic Times article on credit-card lounge access cuts

triage.note: Visa/Mastercard scheme entitlements are private network rules; no allowlisted host carries them.

proposals.label: Credit-card spend-based GST input-tax-credit disallowance → corporate card spend
proposals.mechanism: Tax-authority clarification disallowing or restricting input-tax-credit for corporate credit-card spends reduces corporate incentive for card-based procurement
proposals.required_source: CBIC circular or GST Council decision on input-tax-credit eligibility for credit-card expenses
source_ladder: CBIC Circular under GST Act clarifying ITC on credit-card transactions
GST Council press note or FAQ on corporate credit-card expense treatment
Business Standard or The Hindu article on GST ITC disallowance for credit-card spend

proposals.label: RBI unsecured-retail exposure concentration norm → issuer credit-card limit management
proposals.mechanism: Introduction or tightening of exposure ceilings for unsecured retail (as share of total advances) forces issuers to cap or reduce per-customer credit limits, lowering spend capacity
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on prudential limits for unsecured retail credit or credit-card exposure caps
source_ladder: RBI Master Circular on Exposure Norms or new circular on unsecured retail credit concentration
RBI Financial Stability Report discussing unsecured retail lending concentration risk
Mint or Economic Times article on RBI capping unsecured loan growth or credit-card limits

triage.note: Already carried by force_rbi_unsecured_tightening (RBI/2023-24/85 risk-weight increase).

proposals.label: Festival-season timing shift → quarterly spend volatility
proposals.mechanism: Lunar-calendar festivals (Diwali, Eid) falling in different Gregorian months across years shift seasonal e-commerce and discretionary spend peaks between quarters
proposals.required_source: Indian festival calendar (Diwali, Eid dates) for relevant years cross-referenced with quarterly spend data
source_ladder: Government of India official holiday calendar or Drik Panchang for festival dates
E-commerce industry reports (RedSeer, Bain-Flipkart) on festival sale GMV by quarter
Business Today or ET Retail article on festival-season timing and retail sales

triage.note: Festival timing is a calendar fact, not an external driver.

proposals.label: Foreign-travel reopening → international transaction value surge then normalization
proposals.mechanism: Post-pandemic international travel resumption creates one-time surge in cross-border credit-card spend, subsequently normalizing as pent-up demand exhausts
proposals.required_source: Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) international passenger traffic data or RBI cross-border remittance data
source_ladder: DGCA monthly international passenger traffic statistics
RBI Bulletin data on outward remittances under LRS (Liberalised Remittance Scheme)
Livemint or Business Standard article on international travel recovery and credit-card spends

triage.note: DGCA passenger traffic is an observable series.

proposals.label: Credit-card tokenization friction → saved-card checkout conversion
proposals.mechanism: Mandatory card-on-file tokenization with incomplete merchant adoption or UX friction reduces repeat e-commerce checkout success, lowering transaction volumes
proposals.required_source: RBI circular on card-on-file tokenization mandate and merchant compliance data
source_ladder: RBI circular dated March 2020 or subsequent amendments on card-on-file tokenization
NPCI or Razorpay/Paytm payment gateway report on tokenization adoption rates
Economic Times or Mint article on credit-card tokenization impacting e-commerce checkout

triage.note: Same instrument as [19]; the proposal itself dates it to the March 2020 circular.
